summary: Tested the compound calculator and the AI help chat (Scara, gpt-6-luna), backend and UI. Backend: 12/12 new pytest tests pass in test_assistant_chat.py. They cover SSE streaming with data:{delta} and [DONE], 401 when logged out, 403 for admin/staff/agent, 422 for an empty message, 400 for a bad session id, the bot knowing the balance ($1,039.00), the no-withdrawal answer, multi-turn memory, history persisted in order without _id, and another player getting [] for the demo player's session. UI (desktop and mobile): the calculator defaults show $14,477.28 / $14,377.28 / 144.8x with the disclaimer. 1 year = $3,778.34, 2 weeks = $114.95 (row 14), 6 months = $599.58 (row 180). All 6 presets work, the cap note shows for 20 years, the chart renders, and the last table row (500) matches the final amount. Empty or zero inputs do not crash. Chat: the launcher shows on /app, /app/calculator, /app/deposits and /app/account, and not for admin, staff or agent. Suggestions work and replies stream in (the deposit steps answer was correct). The follow-up 'minimum amount for that?' got the answer $10. History reloads after close/reopen and after a page reload. '+' starts an empty session. The Hinglish question about the referral code got AE843071. Regression: a TEST_ user popup still shows alongside the widget, and the launcher is correctly blocked while the modal is open. Total LLM calls: 6.

minor.issue: No per-user rate limit or quota, so a player can spam LLM calls and run up Emergent key cost.

The user message is saved before the LLM call. If the LLM fails or the client disconnects mid-stream, no assistant reply is saved, which leaves orphan user turns (two user messages in a row in history).

ui_bugs.issue: Extreme inputs overflow: rate 100% for 3650 days shows '$Infinity', 'Infinityx' and '+$NaN' table rows. Clamp the output or show a 'too large' message when the result is not finite.

issues: The fixed chat launcher (bottom-right, 56px) covers the bottom-right content when scrolling, such as the last column of the calculator table. Consider adding bottom padding to main on mobile.
An empty or 0 period silently becomes 1 day ($101.00) with no hint. Minor.

action_items: (Low) Guard non-finite results in Calculator.jsx: if the result is not finite, show a cap or 'too large' text instead of $Infinity/NaN
(Low) Add a simple per-user rate limit on /api/assistant/chat
(Optional) Add bottom padding on mobile so the chat launcher does not cover content
critical_code_review_comments: assistant.py: the reply is only saved when the generator finishes. A client abort cancels the generator, so a partial reply is lost while the user message stays saved.
ChatWidget.jsx: JSON.parse on SSE lines has no try/catch. A malformed chunk would throw and show the generic error. Acceptable.
ChatWidget.jsx: the localStorage session key is not scoped per user. A second player on the same browser reuses the session id, but history is filtered by user_id, so there is no data leak.
GET /api/assistant/history does not enforce role=user. Non-players just get []. Harmless.
seed_data_creation: Created the TEST_ChatRegressionPopup banner and then deleted it by id. Deleted my own chat_messages sessions by id: the test-37e3..., 99271c9b... and 299533ae... sessions. Main agent's sessions (test-session-001, b83dbd86...) were left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with the default pytest.ini (xdist loadscope). TestChatFlow must stay in one class because it is sequential. test_assistant_chat.py makes 3 LLM calls (~5 s total). The demo balance is $1,039, the referral code is AE843071 and the min deposit is $10. Terms re-accept was not triggered this time because require-reaccept is global and affects every user. It was verified in iteration 12.
